events.content:
I've created `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts` that logs every request to the console. Each log line includes the HTTP method and pathname, e.g.:

```
[GET] /
[GET] /about
[POST] /api/data
```

The middleware runs on all routes by default. If you want to exclude static assets (like `_next/static`, images, etc.), you can add a `config` export with a `matcher`:

```ts
export const config = {
  matcher: "/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico).*)",
};
```
